name: Slayer grants the party 3 percent critical strike and its holder 3 more (#3912)
contract: Slayer 300968 is SpellFamily 21, passive (Attributes 0x40), with two effects. Effect 0 is SPELL_EFFECT_APPLY_AREA_AURA_RAID (65) applying SPELL_AURA_MOD_CRIT_PCT (290), BasePoints 2 + DieSides 1 = +3 percent, RadiusIndex 12 (100 yards). Effect 1 is SPELL_AURA_ASCENSION_MOD_CRIT_CHANCE (350), MiscValue 127 (all schools), +3 percent, applied to the caster only, which is the 'in addition, increases your critical strike chance' half; Unit::SpellDoneCritChance adds it for every school (Unit.cpp:9692). 300968 belongs to spell group 2000181 (rev_20260908_05_guardian_completion.sql:320) whose stack rule is 3, SPELL_GROUP_STACK_RULE_EXCLUSIVE_SAME_EFFECT (line 331), over the aura types MOD_CRIT_PCT, MOD_WEAPON_CRIT_PERCENT and MOD_SPELL_CRIT_CHANCE (SpellMgr.cpp:1874); Unit::GetTotalAuraModifier keeps only the highest amount of a same-effect group (Unit.cpp:6559-6575). That is the 'does not stack with similar effects' clause: a second holder grouped with the same member leaves the member at +3. Everything is native aura and spell group data, no script is involved. The holder's spell_done_crit_chance is read on Quickdraw 804193 (DmgClass ranged, physical, not CANT_CRIT), which reads the melee crit field plus aura 350: +3 + +3 = +6. Stacking is exercised with a second Slayer holder rather than a foreign buff so that every step uses only learn and group; the receiver never learns the talent.

steps.label: Let level scaling settle
Group the second Slayer holder with the first
Group the receiver
Receiver melee critical chance before Slayer
Receiver spell critical chance before Slayer
Slayer holder melee critical chance before Slayer
Slayer holder spell critical chance before Slayer
Second holder melee critical chance before any Slayer
Slayer holder Quickdraw critical chance before Slayer
Learn 300968
The party member receives the Slayer raid aura
Party member: melee critical chance is 3 percentage points higher (effect 0, aura 290)
Party member: spell critical chance is 3 percentage points higher
Holder: the raid aura also covers the holder, +3 melee
Holder: +3 spell from the raid aura
Holder: the extra self aura (effect 1, aura 350) makes the native crit chance +6 in total
Learn 300968
Let the second Slayer area aura reach the receiver
Two Slayer holders do not stack on the party member (spell group 2000181, same-effect rule)
Two Slayer holders do not stack on spell critical chance either
The second holder holds two Slayer auras (its own and the first holder's) and still gets the raid bonus once
